fields.description:
As a dispatcher I want to search and filter the aircraft list so that I can find the right aircraft quickly.

Scenario: Search by tail number
  Given I am on the aircraft list page
  When I type a tail number in the search field
  Then only aircraft matching that tail number are displayed

Scenario: Clear search restores full list
  Given I have entered a search term that filters the list
  When I click the clear button
  Then all aircraft are displayed again

Scenario: No results found
  Given I have entered a search term that matches no aircraft
  When the search executes
  Then an empty state message "No aircraft found" is displayed

Scenario: Filter by operational status
  Given I am on the aircraft list page
  When I select "Active" from the status filter
  Then only aircraft with status Active are displayed in the list
